summary: Lawler, as Middle East Subcommittee Chair, pledged continued US military support for Israel in his 2026 campaign, co-introduced H.Res. 1323 rejecting the UN's IDF listing, warned Hamas to "Accept Peace or Face Devastating Consequences," and demanded apologies from Tlaib and "The Squad" for criticizing the Al-Ahli Arab Hospital bombing. He voted for the 2024 Antisemitism Awareness Act and co-sponsored the 2025 version, both incorporating IHRA definitions into federal education enforcement.
